name: StudioFlowIQ Members
subtitle: Your studio, in flow
description: Book your next class, follow reservations and waitlist status, access your studio membership, show your check-in pass, manage your profile and contact support. Studio access is by private invitation. An internet connection is required for bookings and billing.
reviewNotes: Invitation-only access. Supply dedicated review accounts and a sample studio. Purchases cover in-person studio services/retail; no software subscription purchase is exposed in the native client. Do not use live cards for review tests.
